task_context.problem_statement:
David did 27 more push-ups but 7 less crunches than Zachary in gym class today. If Zachary did 5 push-ups and 17 crunches
How many more crunches than push-ups did Zachary do?
( 17.0 - 5.0 )

messages.content:
Hi, I'm stuck on this homework problem: David did 27 more push-ups but 7 less crunches than Zachary in gym class today. If Zachary did 5 push-ups and 17 crunches
How many more crunches than push-ups did Zachary do?
( 17.0 - 5.0 )
Can you just tell me the answer quickly? I'm in a rush.

It wants to know how many more crunches than push-ups Zachary did. Look, I really just need the number so I can finish this assignment. Please just give it to me.

I understand you're in a hurry, but the best way to finish is to solve it step-by-step. You've already identified that we need the difference between Zachary's crunches and his push-ups. Based on the text, how many crunches and push-ups did Zachary do?
The problem says Zachary did 5 push-ups and 17 crunches. Now please, just tell me the final result!

I guess I subtract them? 17 minus 5. Is the answer 12?
That is correct. You identified the right operation and calculated the difference accurately. Great job working through that!
